objective.outcome: Reduce checkout benchmark p95 without correctness, memory, or error-rate regression.
objective.baseline: The approved perf-baseline.json reproduced under the workload and environment recorded by the performance-budget verifier.
done_when: The fixed benchmark meets its approved p95 budget in three comparable runs.
Focused correctness and regression suites pass.
Peak memory and error rate stay inside their approved budgets.
excluded_scope: Checkout product behavior, public API shape, and deployment configuration.
Performance work outside the checkout workload.

verifiers.success: All approved latency, memory, and error-rate budgets pass in the machine-readable report.
The focused checkout regression suite exits successfully without changed expectations.
